hints: "Google Drive Trigger" is a provider webhook (googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_FILE_CREATED_TRIGGER). Create the endpoint and trigger instance, then paste the we_… id and connected account into this node before the first run: `cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper --client-id <id>`, `cdecli webhook endpoint set-data <we_id> --signing-secret <secret>`, `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_FILE_CREATED_TRIGGER --account <connectedAccountId>`.
The original started from errorTrigger; Yantra has no webhook slug for it, so run on demand, on a schedule (add a NodeCron), or via the workflow API with the event under the run input `event`.
"Read video from Google Drive" (writeBinaryFile): Local filesystem / binary helpers become `{ data, fileName, mimeType }` fields on Yantra; there is no host disk.
"Read video from Google Drive": Yantra steps exchange file content as text or base64 fields, not paths on disk. Point this at the upstream file payload.
"Get Audio from Video" transcribes the audio from "Google Drive" with the platform Whisper; no OpenAI key needed.
"Read Video from Google Drive" (readBinaryFile): Local filesystem / binary helpers become `{ data, fileName, mimeType }` fields on Yantra; there is no host disk.

"Read Video from Google Drive2" (readBinaryFile): Local filesystem / binary helpers become `{ data, fileName, mimeType }` fields on Yantra; there is no host disk.

"Upload Video and Description to Tiktok" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Upload Video and Description to Tiktok" sends its multipart-form-data body with yantra-storage HTTP_SEND (public https hosts only, 25 MB, 120 s); the file comes from "Google Drive".
"Upload Video and Description to Instagram" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Upload Video and Description to Instagram" sends its multipart-form-data body with yantra-storage HTTP_SEND (public https hosts only, 25 MB, 120 s); the file comes from "Google Drive".
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect telegram: `cdecli credential create -n "telegram" -p telegram --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Description
This automation allows you to upload a video to a configured Google Drive folder, and it will automatically create descriptions and upload it to Instagram and TikTok.

## How to Use
1. Generate an API token at upload-post.com and add to Upload to Tiktok and Upload to Instagram nodes
2. Configure your Google Drive folder
3. Customize the OpenAI prompt for your specific use case
4. Optional: Configure Telegram for error notifications

## Requirements
- upload-post.com account
- Google Drive account
- OpenAI API key
